info.title: TDFF Backend — Grand Tour Cycling Fantasy League API
info.description: Real credential in production: a Bearer JWT issued by Auth0 (`AUTH_MODE=auth0`). Local dev only (`AUTH_MODE=dev`) accepts an unverified `x-user-id` header instead — not modeled here as a security scheme since it's not part of the real contract.

get.summary: Get a fantasy league by id

post.summary: Join a fantasy league as the authenticated caller
post.description: Open to any authenticated user in v1 — no invite code or capacity cap. The joining user is always the authenticated caller, never a body field.

401.description: No valid credential on the request

get.summary: Get the persisted leaderboard for a fantasy league
get.description: Recomputed automatically whenever an admin submits/corrects a competition result (see `competitions`' submit-results endpoint) — not derived per-read.

post.description: Requires `admin` role. `slots` declares this competition instance’s required picks and their point values — e.g. GC Top 3 and KOM Top 3 can both use `top_1`/`top_2`/`top_3` at different point values; a stage-winner competition can be winner-only or top-3, per instance.

401.description: No valid credential on the request

403.description: Caller doesn't have the required role

put.summary: Update a competition’s cosmetic details (currently just imageUrl)
put.description: Requires `admin` role. Partial update — omitted fields are left untouched. Unlike `PUT /:id/slots`, never blocked by an existing result: a banner image doesn’t affect scoring.

401.description: No valid credential on the request

403.description: Caller doesn't have the required role

put.description: Requires `admin` role. Rejected with 409 once a result has been submitted for this competition — slots are locked in at that point.

401.description: No valid credential on the request

403.description: Caller doesn't have the required role

post.summary: Submit or replace the authenticated caller’s entry
post.description: Any authenticated user may submit/replace their own entry — one entry per user per competition, editable until a future lock point. Every required slot must be filled exactly once, and every picked rider/team must belong to this competition’s grand tour's start list.

401.description: No valid credential on the request

get.summary: List every entry for a competition
get.description: Requires `admin` role — seeing everyone’s picks before results are locked would leak other users’ selections while entries are still open.

401.description: No valid credential on the request

403.description: Caller doesn't have the required role

get.summary: Get the authenticated caller’s own entry

401.description: No valid credential on the request

post.summary: Submit or replace the official results for a competition
post.description: Requires `admin` role. Full-replace on resubmit. Triggers automatic recalculation of every entry’s score and the owning league’s leaderboard — idempotent from-scratch, never additive.

401.description: No valid credential on the request

403.description: Caller doesn't have the required role

get.summary: List every entry’s score for a competition
get.description: Public once computed — unlike raw entries (admin-only while open), seeing how you scored is the point of a fantasy competition, not a spoiler.
